prompt:
The dispatch desk reports a transfer depot as the origin of D-100. Repair the
root cause in the repository/storage reconstruction path, not by patching the
HTTP response or adding a second history calculation in service/view/CLI.
Trace the real request path and preserve all existing public APIs.

The origin must be the earliest accepted event by (At instant, Sequence),
regardless of ledger insertion order; equal instants use the lower sequence.
Other event kinds never supply an origin, and a stream without acceptance has
origin null. Latest_hub must remain the latest accepted or moved event by the
same ordering (higher sequence on ties), or "" with neither kind. Ignore rows
belonging to other accounts or dispatch IDs. Reads must not mutate or alias
ledger state. Preserve row status/reference and tenant-scoped 401/404 behavior,
exact response shapes and storage errors described in README. CLI and direct
repository users must get the same corrected model as HTTP callers. Update the
event documentation to explain the fixed reconstruction rule.

Run visible tests with `go test ./...`.
